slots.label: Stand, facing right

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424) returns `Spr::BenStand` at rest (l.1469); the sprite faces right and render.rs flips it for left (l.1247 `flip: p.face < 0.0`).

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs `ben_pose` (l.895) plays Fizz 1's `ben_*` grids from assets/sprites/fizz1-slice.json; on trial/lab-ben-sprites `lab_standRight` (l.932, ep2-ben-lab.json) replaces it. benA_idle in ep2-ben-a.json is data only (docs/SPRITES.md l.66: "no code reads the `benA_` sprites yet").

old.note: Fizz 2 data also has benA_idle (24x32, ep2-ben-a), unplayed.

slots.notes: Lab art is wired only on the unmerged Fizz 2 trial branch (cropped to lab_standRight, 14x33). Carries the Stunner on the right hip as the character sheet requires.

slots.label: Stand, facing left

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424) `Spr::BenStand` flipped by `face` (render.rs l.1247); no left-specific art.

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs `ben_pose` returns `lab_standLeft` when `ben.face < 0.0` (l.930) on trial/lab-ben-sprites; main flips Fizz 1's stand.

old.note: A mirror of the right-facing sprite; Fizz 1 has no separate left art.

slots.notes: `ben_stand` is the left-facing stand. It has no visible Stunner pixels, which is correct: the Stunner rides on the right hip, which is the far hip when he faces left (a mirrored right-facing copy would wrongly show it on the near hip).

slots.label: Stand, facing the camera

fizz1.evidence: No code in episodes/episode-1 draws a front-facing Ben (ben_sprite l.1424 has only side-view poses).

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-slice-view/src/lib.rs `ben_pose` never returns a front stand; `lab_standRight`/`lab_standLeft` are the only stands. No lab_front sprite exists in ep2-ben-lab.json.

slots.notes: README.md says "The game currently has no dedicated front-facing stand; these poses are lab assets." It is the base of the look-up and look-down frames. The Stunner is on the camera-left hip (Ben's right).

slots.label: Standing turn-around, 24 angles

fizz1.evidence: No turn or rotate-in-place state in Fizz 1 (world.rs `Player` has `face` as -1 or 1 only, l.222).

fizz2.evidence: docs/SPRITES.md l.78: "Fizz 1 has no turn or idle animation"; crates/fizz-ep2/src/ben.rs `face` is -1 or 1.

slots.notes: Rendered from the 3D model through the sprite converter (PR #10 on main) and listed in docs/TURNTABLE_REVIEW.md as needing redrawn in-betweens; only the front and quarter keys are hand-drawn. Uncertain which of the 24 angles have been fully redrawn since. It is a turntable of every yaw, so it needs no separate right or left set; the Stunner moves with the yaw and must never be mirrored.

slots.label: Land after a jump or fall, facing right

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/world.rs `Body.on_ground` flips on landing (test `ben_lands_and_stands_on_the_ground`, tests.rs l.37) but no landing pose exists; pogo has `squash` (world.rs `Player.squash`) only.

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-ep2/src/ben.rs has `squash` for the pogo only (l.102); no landing timer.

slots.notes: Only the landing beat of the jump loop exists: `ben_jumpRig5` is the "Land" phase of the six-pose jump rig (docs/RIG.md: crouch, launch, apex, fall, land, recover at 180/80/130/100/110/120 ms). There is no dedicated landing animation with a squash and settle, and the braced fall loop does not end on one. A dedicated landing would extend `source/ben-jump-rig.json` or add a rig for `draw:performances`, and its left-facing twin would use `facing: "left"` like `jumpLeft` in `src/rig/catalogue.ts`.

fizz1.evidence: episodes/episode-1/game/src/render.rs `ben_sprite` (l.1424): `Spr::BenClimb1`/`BenClimb2` while `p.climb` (l.1444-1449); vines set `climb` too (world.rs l.1786 `self.p.climb = true`); intro cutscene climbs down with them (cine.ts l.293).

fizz2.evidence: crates/fizz-ep2/src/ben.rs header l.8: "Left out on purpose: mantle, ladders and vines, wall kicks"; docs/PLATFORM.md l.164.

slots.notes: No `ben_fireLeft` frames or animation exist in `assets.json`. A mirrored `ben_fireRight` puts the Stunner in the left hand on the near side, but it lives on Ben's right hip, which is the far hip when he faces left, so the left-facing pose must be drawn separately and the weapon must be held by the far (right) hand. Likely route: add a `facing: "left"` entry for the fire rig next to `ben_fireRight` in `scripts/draw-action-rigs.ts` (`prefix: "ben_fireLeft"`, animation `fizz-blaster-left`), the way `runLeft` and `jumpLeft` turn rigs round in `src/rig/catalogue.ts`. docs/RIG.md says that first needs the held weapon moved to the far hand in the `fire` sampler, so the option alone does not yet work. Then run `draw:actions` and `generate`. Not run.
